title: A population can reach extinction
hook: Two stated cases: explore the offspring distribution in a bounded extinction model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the offspring distribution in a bounded extinction model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Extinct, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the offspring distribution in a bounded extinction model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
